messages:
Jordan (CSM): Kicking off onboarding for Nebula Health. Main goals: production-safe API integration, observable rollout (metrics + alerts), and a short enablement for their support team. Looping in @Sam @Priya @Maya @Ethan. Quick Q: does everyone prefer a D+30 or D+45 go-live target?

Sam (Solutions Eng): D+30 is tight but doable if we get their staging creds and sample payloads within 3 business days. I can take the integration checklist and run a smoke test.

Priya (Onboarding Eng): I'll own test harness + sample data ingestion. Need their schema for PHI fields to ensure our redaction rules match. Jordan can you confirm data classification?

Jordan (CSM): Yes, Nebula will send synthetic PII/PHI examples for testing. I'll request the dataset and add it to the secure bucket.

Maya (Product): Product acceptance criteria: 1) end-to-end request/response matches contract, 2) events emitted for request_id, latency_ms, model_version, 3) anomaly alert on >=3% error rate during pilot. Will share event schema by EOD.

Ethan (Customer Success Lead): I'll track health and renewal signals. Two risk flags to monitor: slower than expected latency on nightly loads, and low engagement from their mobile team. We should plan a post-pilot NPS + feedback survey.

Sam (Solutions Eng): Noted. For perf we should define target percentiles. Propose: P50 < 120ms, P90 < 400ms for 512-token median payload. Thoughts?

Priya (Onboarding Eng): Those look reasonable. We'll run a 6h perf window during D+21 to validate. If we see P90 spikes we can suggest batching or reduced quantization.

Jordan (CSM): Draft timeline below. Call out any blockers by EOD tomorrow or we'll lock this.

```
D+0: kickoff + intro to Nebula ops
D+3: staging creds + sample payloads received
D+7: initial integration + smoke tests
D+14: acceptance tests & analytics events verified
D+21: perf window + tuning recommendations
D+30: pilot (gradual traffic ramp)
D+45: fallback deadline / full go-live if pilot needs extra time
```

Maya (Product): I can validate D+14 acceptance tests. Please add me to their staging project.

Ethan (Customer Success Lead): I'll prepare the 30/60/90 stakeholder comms and the post-pilot survey.

Sam (Solutions Eng): I'll grab D+3 creds and post them to #secure-keys when ready. Also will add whitelist request for their IPs.

Priya (Onboarding Eng): Small blocker: our test harness needs token rotation support for short-lived creds. I'll prototype over the next 48h.

Jordan (CSM): Good call. I'll notify Nebula to provide a token with a longer TTL for the initial run, and then we'll move to rotated tokens.

OnboardBot: Reminder: upload kickoff notes to /onboards/nebula within 24h. Meeting invite created for 2026-05-02 15:00 UTC.

Jordan (CSM): Recap of owners: Jordan = client comms + dataset, Sam = integration + perf setup, Priya = harness + tuning, Maya = acceptance tests, Ethan = health/dashboard + comms. If no objections I'll share the runbook and calendar invite.

Ethan (Customer Success Lead): No objections. I'll add the renewal-risk checklist to the runbook and kick off the survey template.

Sam (Solutions Eng): :thumbsup: Ready to start as soon as creds arrive.

Priya (Onboarding Eng): All set from my side.

Jordan (CSM): Thanks team — I'll send the intro to their Dir Ops and drop the synthetic dataset link once it's available.
